author: JustOneMoreShot
notes_extra: 150g Berger VLD Hunting. Tikka T3 Lite. Chronograph readings 3178 and 3133 fps, and one error, on a Shooting F1 Chrony. Three-shot group at 200 yards later measured 0.780 in, which he called 0.372 MOA. 90 degrees plus.

author: JustOneMoreShot
notes_extra: 150g Berger VLD Hunting. Chronograph readings 3152, 3094, and 3109 fps. Two holes touching at 200 yards and the third 32 mm away.

author: Lrt307
